verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only the `skills` CLI (add/use/list/update/remove/init) and the SKILL.md specification; nothing shows an official SDK or programmatic library for building against skills.sh. A CLI is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here, and a community request for a REST API (skills-cli-comm-9) suggests no programmatic interface exists. For a registry/CLI product an official SDK is a plausible offering, so the axis applies and absence of evidence is "none".
